Drops of Love Food Pantry

EVERYTHING HELPS

The Church of The Good Shepherd, through our Social Ministry, has a food pantry which is open on Tuesdays 10:30-12:00. Our Mission is to provide 3 meals a day for 3 days to those in need.  It is mainly for the vulnerable members of our community who do not have a job or anyone to support them to run through the day or a week. Primarily this is an emergency basis pantry.

All of the food that we share is provided by our parishioners or any person who wants to support our cause.  Currently, we receive no local, state, or federal funds. We are able to keep the pantry going through the dedicated volunteers or donors who contribute weekly or in bits through the year. We thank everyone who contributes to this noble cause for their continued generosity and support as we help fulfill the mission of our Lord and Savior.

 

NEEDS LIST: Spaghetti Sauce, canned vegetables, canned meats, tuna, soups, peanut butter, jelly, cereal, mac-n-cheese.
